title: Bit-flip is an involution
statement: For a point $x$ in the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$ and a coordinate $i$, flipping the $i$-th coordinate of $x$ twice returns the original point: $(x^i)^i = x$.
hypotheses_covered: x a point of the Boolean hypercube of dimension n
i a coordinate index in Fin n
replaced:
Flipping coordinate $i$ twice returns the original point:
$(x^i)^i = x$.
